You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import collections, json
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr={i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1}
    sc={j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1}
    sepc=g[list(sr)[0]][0]
    def groups(seq):
        out=[];cur=[seq[0]]
        for x in seq[1:]:
            if x-cur[-1]==1: cur.append(x)
            else: out.append(cur); cur=[x]
        out.append(cur); return out
    Rg=groups([i for i in range(H) if i not in sr]); Cg=groups([j for j in range(W) if j not in sc])
    vals=[g[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if i not in sr and j not in sc]

import collections
def groups(seq):
    out=[];cur=[seq[0]]
    for x in seq[1:]:
        if x-cur[-1]==1: cur.append(x)
        else: out.append(cur); cur=[x]
    out.append(cur); return out
def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    sr={i for i in range(H) if len(set(gi[i]))==1}; sc={j for j in range(W) if len({gi[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1}
    sepc=gi[list(sr)[0]][0]
    Rg=groups([i for i in range(H) if i not in sr]); Cg=groups([j for j in range(W) if j not in sc])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if i not in sr and j not in sc).most_common()
    bg,fill=cnt[0][0],cnt[1][0]
    best=max(collections.Counter(v for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if i not in sr and j not in sc).values())
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for ri,rg in enumerate(Rg):
        for cj,cg in enumerate(Cg):
            blk=[(i,j) for i in rg for j in cg]
            n=sum(1 for i,j in blk if gi[i][j]!=bg and gi[i][j]!=sepc)
            if n==best and n>0:
                for i,j in blk: out[i][j]=fill
    return out
ok=True
for p in (1,2,3,4,5):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    r_=solve(gi)
    m=(r_==go)
    ok=ok and m
    print(p,'match' if m else 'MISMATCH')
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAIL')
res=solve(G['Test input'])
import json
print(json.dumps(res))

import json
def groups(seq):
    seq=sorted(seq); out=[];cur=[seq[0]]
    for x in seq[1:]:
        if x-cur[-1]==1: cur.append(x)
        else: out.append(cur); cur=[x]
    out.append(cur); return out

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    srs=sorted(i for i in range(H) if len(set(gi[i]))==1)
    scols=sorted(j for j in range(W) if len({gi[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1)
    Rg=groups([i for i in range(H) if i not in srs]); Cg=groups([j for j in range(W) if j not in scols])
    vals=collections.Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_ if x!=gi[srs[0]][0])
    # dot color = least common? use second-most-common among tile cells; simpler: colors excluding sep
    sep=gi[srs[0]][0]
    tvals=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_ if v!=sep)
    order=[v for v,_ in tvals.most_common()]
    bg=order[0]; dot=order[1] if len(order)>1 else None
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    mc=[v for v,_ in tvals.most_common() if v!=bg]
    dot=min(mc,key=lambda v:tvals[v]) if mc else None
    counts=[[sum(1 for a in rg for b in cg if gi[a][b]==dot) for cg in Cg] for rg in Rg]
    M=max(max(row) for row in counts) if counts else 0
    for ri,rg in enumerate(Rg):
        for cj,cg in enumerate(Cg):
            if counts[ri][cj]==M:
                for a in rg:
                    for b in cg:
                        if gi[a][b]!=sep: out[a][b]=dot
    return out

out=f(G['Test input'])

import collections, os, re, json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

        print(''.join(str(v) if (i not in srs and j not in scols) else '.' for j,v in enumerate(r_)), end='  ')

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

G=load()

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def grouper(seq):
    seq=sorted(seq); out=[];cur=[seq[0]]
    for x in seq[1:]:
        if x-cur[-1]==1: cur.append(x)
        else: out.append(cur); cur=[x]
    out.append(cur); return out

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
